description:
Ambalavayal, near Sulthan Bathery in Wayanad, is a charming village known for its mix of natural beauty and cultural heritage, making it a must‑visit stop for tourists. It is home to the famous Edakkal Caves, the Wayanad Heritage Museum, and scenic spots like Cheengeri Hills and Karapuzha Dam.
  • Distance from Sulthan Bathery: ~10 km (easy road access).
  • Nearby Towns: Kalpetta (21 km), Meppadi (16 km), Vythiri (32 km).
name: Ambalvayal

description: Nestled in the foothills of the Western Ghats, Bandipur is one of India’s most renowned tiger reserves and a haven for wildlife enthusiasts. Home to elephants, deer, leopards, and a rich variety of birdlife, the sanctuary offers an unforgettable experience of nature at its purest. A guided safari through its lush forests lets you witness the vibrant biodiversity and the tranquil beauty of this protected paradise.

description: Set amidst lush coffee and tea plantations, Kalpetta is a charming hill town and the gateway to Wayanad’s natural wonders. Just 72 km from Kozhikode, it offers easy access to attractions like Chembra Peak, Soochipara Falls, and Edakkal Caves. With its serene landscapes, rich Jain heritage, and vibrant local culture, Kalpetta is an ideal base for exploring the beauty and adventure of Wayanad.

description: A charming town on the banks of the Kabini River, Mananthavady is known for its lush forests, wildlife, and cultural heritage. It serves as a gateway to the famous Tholpetty Wildlife Sanctuary and offers easy access to trekking trails, ancient churches, and tribal villages. With its serene landscapes and rich traditions, Mananthavady is perfect for travelers seeking both adventure and authentic Wayanad experiences

description: Known as the “Land of Seetha Devi,” Pulpally is a serene town surrounded by lush forests, spice plantations, and rich cultural heritage. With its peaceful ambience and proximity to wildlife sanctuaries, Pulpally is an ideal stop for those seeking a soulful Wayanad experience.

With its rich biodiversity and pristine landscapes, Tholpetty is a must-visit destination for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

description: A charming hill station nestled in the Western Ghats, Vythiri is renowned for its mist-covered peaks, lush rainforests, and tranquil streams. Surrounded by tea and coffee plantations, it offers a refreshing escape with attractions like Pookode Lake, Soochipara Falls, and treehouse stays. With its cool climate and serene ambience, Vythiri is the perfect destination for nature lovers and honeymooners alike.
